note: Hand-authored source of distribution truth. web/tests/docs/contextPackageValidator.test.ts binds it to the certified documents; it is not generated and must not be regenerated from prose.

cross_lane_rule.statement: A task that materially affects more than one lane picks exactly ONE primary mutation lane.
steps: choose one primary mutation lane and record it
load secondary lane DIRECT context read-only
fire recertification checks for every affected lane
never open duplicate competing work in a secondary lane

lanes.purpose: The external partner contract and the internal admin API, kept apart.
owns: the /api/v1 public surface and its contract
the public scope catalog and error taxonomy
does_not_own: the domain semantics behind any endpoint — those belong to the domain lane
outbound partner event delivery, which does not exist
safe: Alloy has two APIs and they share no contract
the public surface is closed: 18 paths, no generic PUT/PATCH/DELETE
Attendance is public; Financials and Communications are not
forbidden: that an /api/admin behaviour applies to /api/v1 or the reverse
that a public operation exists because an internal one does
that the generated partner package is a second source of truth
that Alloy has no partner API — it is versioned and certified

lanes.purpose: The foundational runtimes that interpret configuration and render the operator plane.
owns: the presentation tree and reveal contract
does_not_own: product URLs and redirects (see the product-urls shared concern)
what a stage or status MEANS (business-process)
safe: authoritative record detail comes from the resolver-backed entity GET, never a queue preview
Work Views, Queues and lane badges are projections
runtime construction is frozen; a new foundational runtime requires an RFC
forbidden: that a queue page is a cohort or a badge count is a fact
that the two still-proposed runtime documents are authority
that an empty surface means no data exists

lanes.purpose: Process position and governed disposition: stage, status, outcome, work.
owns: Organization to Business Process to Stage to Record hierarchy
safe: persisted Stage is process position
Status does not define Stage
lane membership is stage AND status
forbidden: that Status defines or derives Stage
that a filtered queue page is a cohort
that an authored status_key is anything more than a disposition

lanes.purpose: Who someone is, and what they may do. Capability authorization and tenant isolation.
does_not_own: what a domain action MEANS once authorized
the public API token exchange contract (developer-platform-api)
safe: RLS owns tenant isolation; route capabilities authorize product actions
Person is canonical identity; contacts is compatibility only
email does not define Person identity
forbidden: that a route with no capability call is ungated — authority may live in a service, handler library, registered action or token boundary
that a table grant with no admitting policy is permissive; absence is not a wildcard
that a capability's name implies its scope

lanes.purpose: Placement candidates, enrollment agreements, and where a child is placed.
owns: enrollment agreements and their site consistency
placement supersession as a product behaviour
safe: a placement allows at most one operational row per agreement
a future-dated placement change closes the present one immediately
a cancelled row is retained, not deleted
forbidden: that a cross-site move is represented — it is not, deliberately
that latest row means active row
that a correction path exists because an edit form does

lanes.purpose: Employment, staff assignment and coverage expectation.
owns: employment records and staff subject identity
staff assignment eligibility and coverage authority
does_not_own: attendance observation — schedule is expectation, not observation
safe: staff primary assignments are overlap-governed only
a staff member may hold a current and a future-dated primary assignment at once
schedule is expectation; Attendance is observation
staff supply is schedule_assignments with subject_type='staff' — there is no shift model
forbidden: that one cardinality rule covers every effective-dated table
that Scheduling is Attendance truth
that a shift model exists

lanes.purpose: Observed presence: immutable attendance facts and their producers.
does_not_own: expected presence — that is staff-scheduling and enrollment-placement
safe: Attendance is observation, not expectation
attendance facts are immutable
attendance is permission-gated, not flag-gated
attendance is exposed on the public API
forbidden: that a schedule implies an attendance record
that an attendance fact may be edited in place
that kiosk identity is the same as operator identity

lanes.purpose: Collection suppression from third-party funding. Derived, never stored.
owns: the suppression calculation and its bounds
does_not_own: obligation, reduction, responsibility or payment — subsidy changes none of them
safe: subsidy suppresses collection and is derived, never stored
only a SUBMITTED claim suppresses
suppression is bounded by the smallest of claimed, expected and outstanding
there is no mounted HTTP write surface — subsidy is command-dispatched
forbidden: that subsidy is a payment
that an authorization or draft claim suppresses collection
that a shortfall raises what the family owes

lanes.purpose: Pricing intent: catalog, rates, policies, accounting configuration.
owns: fees, add-ons, deposits and discount programs
does_not_own: the obligation its pricing produces — Commercial owns intent only
safe: Commercial owns pricing intent, not the resulting obligation
childcare tuition lives in commercial_tuition_rates, not the retired pricing_* vertical
forbidden: that a quote is an obligation
that Commercial owns the obligation its pricing produces
that the pricing_* tables describe childcare tuition — they administer the retired Jobs/Booking vertical

lanes.purpose: Deterministic derivation: metrics, calculations and Answers.
owns: registered metric keys and the metric platform
Answer production and its consumer surfaces
does_not_own: acting on an answer — an OI reading authorizes nothing
safe: an OI answer is a reading, not an action
intelligence is not a catch-all for every derived datum — four output families exist and differ by authored versus derived
OI confers no mutation authority
forbidden: that an OI recommendation is an action
that a derived datum is authored truth
that asking a question authors a record

lanes.purpose: What the organization meant to send, and what a provider did with it.
owns: the canonical enqueue path and send intent
does_not_own: provider delivery state as business truth
identity resolution of inbound senders (identity-access, processing)
safe: Alloy owns intent; the provider owns transport
provider delivery state is not business truth
only operator triage resolves an attention item
forbidden: that a reply clears attention
that a delivered or bounced webhook resolves operator work
that a named provider is in use because a document mentions it

lanes.purpose: Org-authored intent, and the four distinct lifecycles that publish it.
owns: the four configuration lifecycles and their asymmetry
entity layouts and their append-only rule
safe: configuration expresses intent; the runtime owns execution
entity_layouts is append-only — republish, never edit or delete
four distinct configuration lifecycles exist, not one
the Programs publication chain is built with zero rows
forbidden: that configuration is uniformly versioned — three of the four lifecycles are not
that JSON can create or weaken an invariant
that the Programs publication chain is in use
that a config_assist proposal carries mutation authority

lanes.purpose: Model-backed reasoning behind the Trust boundary, and what it may not do.
owns: the Trust boundary and provider port
does_not_own: mutation authority — applying a proposal takes the domain's capability
autonomous agent behaviour, which does not exist
safe: AI reasoning confers no mutation authority
two of four Trust capabilities reach a model; two are deterministic
the live gate is credential presence plus org policy, not a boolean flag
lib/trust contains no fetch, no SDK and no credential
forbidden: that every /api/admin/ai/* route invokes a model
that a configurable base URL means multi-provider support
that autonomous agents are current behaviour
that AI reasoning authorizes a mutation

shared_context_packages.purpose: The one law for effective-dated operational truth. A shared dependency, never a mutation lane of its own.
owns: truth intervals, supersession, cancellation and correction
cardinality mechanisms and their deliberate asymmetry
does_not_own: any domain's product decisions — it owns mechanics only
safe: effective-dated truth supersedes rather than overwrites
cardinality is NOT uniform: placements and child primary assignments are single-operational; staff is overlap-governed only
no correction path is implemented, deliberately
the primitive emits no events — the calling service does, after commit
forbidden: that one cardinality rule covers every table
that latest row means active row
that a date makes a record effective-dated — only a bounded interval of asserted truth does

shared_context_packages.purpose: Browser URL contract, redirects and rewrites. Shared because three lanes link into it.
owns: the three canonical bases and their redirects
the rewrite mapping onto the implementation tree
does_not_own: what any surface does once routed
safe: /organization is the configuration landing
/settings/* holds settings sub-surfaces
/admin/* remains canonical as a prefix for non-settings modules
all three bases are rewritten onto web/app/adminV2/**
forbidden: that the configuration control plane is /admin/settings
that a URL path matches its filesystem path

pending_lanes.purpose: Money movement: obligation, collection, refund, reversal, ledger. NOT certified; provides no DIRECT context.
owns: (when certified) obligation, collection, refund, reversal and the financial journal
does_not_own: subsidy suppression — certified separately in the subsidy lane
pricing intent — certified separately in the commercial lane
forbidden: that current payment semantics may be inferred from existing Payments or Billing documents
that this lane may supply DIRECT context while PENDING_DISABLED
that Financials is certified because Subsidy and Commercial are
while_pending: context is NOT certified for this lane
fetch implementation and live evidence instead of loading doctrine
do not infer current payment semantics from stale documents
lane certification is required before this becomes standard AI context
the stable boundaries that MAY be relied on: subsidy is collection suppression (certified), Commercial owns pricing intent only (certified)
